steps.title: Add fuel
steps.say: Put [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder) in the fuel slot. 1 powder brews 20 times.

steps.title: Fill bottles
steps.say: Make [glass bottles](item:glass_bottle) from [glass](item:glass), fill them at water, and put up to 3 in the bottom slots.

steps.title: Add nether wart
steps.say: Put [nether wart](item:nether_wart) in the top slot to make awkward [potions](item:potion). Nether wart grows in Nether fortresses.

steps.title: Pick a power
steps.say: Add one more thing on top: [sugar](item:sugar) for speed, a [golden carrot](item:golden_carrot) for night vision, or a [glistering melon slice](item:glistering_melon_slice) for healing.

steps.title: More potions
steps.say: [Magma cream](item:magma_cream) makes fire resistance, a [pufferfish](mob:pufferfish) makes water breathing, and [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder) makes strength.

steps.title: Make them better
steps.say: [Glowstone dust](item:glowstone_dust) makes a [potion](item:potion) stronger, and redstone makes it last longer. [Gunpowder](item:gunpowder) turns it into a [splash potion](item:splash_potion) you throw.
